text:
Maya: Hey team — intake for Peregrine-8B bring-up. Primary asks: ctx sweeps (512/1024/2048/4096), batch profiles (1..16), and int8 quant smoke. Goal: perf baseline + quick quality check. Any blockers?
Sam: On it. Suggest also measuring kv-cache warmup at startup and 2-stage batching (prefill + gen).
Eli: I can run the throughput matrix on the g4 pool tomorrow AM. Do we want CPU-side tokenization timings included? :thinking_face:
Rohan: @Eli yes please — tokenizer + postprocess adds ~5-10ms on sample workloads. Also add a prefix-cache probe (cold vs warm).
bench-ci: CI job queued: peregrine-8b/throughput-matrix#2026-03-21-01
Params: ctx=[512,1024,2048,4096], batch=[1,2,4,8,16], q=[fp16,int8]
Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/12345
Maya: Checklist (inline):
- run coldstart latency (empty KV)
- run warmup sweep (1k tokens prefill)
- batch throughput with and without prefix cache
- int8 vs fp16 latency/throughput
- quick evals: lm-perplexity on eval-set, 50 safety prompts
- capture token-level timings and mem / GPU util

Example command:
```
bench-run --model peregrine-8b --ctx 2048 --batch 8 --tokens 1024 --quant int8 --out ./runs/peregrine/2048_b8_int8
```
Eli: Running coldstart now, will post logs. ETA ~30m
bench-ci: coldstart run complete: https://ci.internal/redwood/runs/54321 — 1st-token latency 120ms, 95p 230ms, gpu util 45%
Sam: 120ms coldstart looks reasonable. Can you also capture steady-state gen (after 5k tokens) so we can compare?
Eli: Started steady-state probe — looks like int8 improves throughput ~18% but some tail latency jitter. Saving flamegraph.
Rohan: Quality spot check: comparing fp16 vs int8 on 200 prompts: avg rouge-L diff ~0.7, but 3 prompts had hallucinations. Flagging for eval team. @Maya
Maya: Thanks. For prioritization: if int8 regression >1.5 on any metric, escalate to research; otherwise we can ship with int8 by default but enable fp16 fallback for critical routes. Added to onboarding doc.
Sam: Action items:
- Eli: finish full matrix + upload artifacts
- Bench team: run lm-perp and 50-shot QA probe
- Research: triage the 3 hallucination cases
- Eng-sre: schedule a dedicated node if throughput steady-state >3k tok/s
Eli: Uploading artifacts now: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/peregrine/4298765432/matrix.zip
